items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: Ray Brown came in and... said, 'Ella’s going to need a bass player, would you like to go with her?' And I said, 'well okay,' so I went the first time in ‘64. And I stayed a year.

ctx.x: In fact I was just there, last time I was there was about five years ago I think it was for the Concord Jazz Festival, but I went over there with Ella two times, two, three times.
When you’re working with a guitar trio, that gives you a lot more room to be a like major soloist almost.
